headline: Ghana Recovers Over GH¢18 Billion From Audit Recommendations
summary: Ghana's Auditor-General announced that the country recovered over GH¢18 billion through the implementation of audit recommendations between 2022 and 2025.
why: Improved public financial management and audit recoveries are critical for Ghana's fiscal consolidation and debt sustainability efforts.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Recovering billions in public funds improves fiscal health and transparency.
